title: the 2x4 noiseless shot plan (D3'-R at y = 1), its convergence in the exact emulation, the decoder acceptance, the IR-L0 bundles and the GPU slot contents (prompts/36)

criteria.name: A1 acceptance: factorised = exhaustive at 2x2 and 2x3 (counts and the four reasons), 2x4 counted, Monte-Carlo 1e7 strings (seed 36) within 3 sigma, Phys reads the file
A2 E_tol per sector = E_R(R u top 80 % of S999) - E0 > 0 (h1_energy_tolerance(H, prob, refs, 0.8, 1e-3))

A3 plan: D3'-R at y = 1 feasible (LP optimal), 60 circuits each >= 267, k = 4 top-up recorded, P(recall S999 >= 0.9) >= 0.95 per sector; information columns f = 0.10 / 0.05 with HQC (no device exists for this)
A4.0 CV0 structural (prompts/30): nested prefixes, E_R(B_all) non-increasing, E_R >= E0 - 1e-9, the sequence histogram = measure_and_decode, the k = 5 stream replay = cache

A4 CV on the exact emulation (3 seeds, prefixes of 8 N samples at f = 1, p_ro = 0): the smallest s in {1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8} at which CV1, CV2, CV4, CV5 hold in all seeds and both sectors; CV3 (k = 4 -> 5, equal shots) <= E_tol in every seed (STOP otherwise)
A5 certificates at the final plan (every seed): recall S999 >= 0.9; E0 inside Kato-Temple (exact E1) at B=0 / Weinstein at B=1; E_R >= E0 - 1e-9; W >= 0.99

A6 slot contents ci/parts/QV_2x4_02..07: plan shots, seeds chunk_seed(s0(token), circuit index, 0, shots), QPY gz sha256, n_instructions, predicted_s <= 2700 at the S2_2x4 rate (06 native / 07 may be withheld, R7); token indices unchanged; slot 01 byte-identical to 6b8f8fc

A7 bundles: 75 IR-L0 qpy13 bundles (60 family + 15 k = 5) with gz sha256 and n_instructions in the index; n_instructions == k x 142288 (as written in prompts/36 A7); the two slot-01 structured sources byte- or gate-for-gate identical; total <= 60 MB; round trip on qiskit 1.4.3

A8 regression: pytest (coding) and the 1.4.3 twin tests pass, check_package PACKAGE OK, Q0P_2x3 reproduced criterion by criterion (in memory), the 2x3 / 2x2 records unchanged, dry runs QV_2x4_02..05 (R14) PASS with segments_cumulative_check
A9 noisy information (R8): N x f0 for N in 1e2 / 1e4 / 1e6 per scenario, no shot sampled

cluster_diag.oracle_order_note: O is ordered by the gate's ground state (BLAS one thread: identical in repeated gate processes, checked 2026-10-19).  scratch/executor36/oracle_b1.py ran with a 4-thread BLAS pool, and the top-|B| boundary of O cuts groups of near-equal weights whose order depends on the round-off of the reference eigensolve; multi-thread reductions are not bit-reproducible, so the scratch values are reproduced to 1e-9 only where the boundary does not cut such a group (scratch/executor36/oracle_threads.py: a 4-thread run reproduced 1583 / 1538 to 1e-15, a later 4-thread child process did not).  The r_H(O) differences are recorded per seed; they do not touch any criterion (D2 is information)
cluster_diag.basis: B_all(8 N) u refs per seed; O = refs u the oracle top-|B| of psi_0 weight (controls.oracle on the sector reference's ground state)
cluster_diag.scratch_check_rule: prompts/36a addendum A2: |r_H(O) - scratch| <= 1e-5 per seed, information only (never a pass criterion); the gate-internal one-thread reproducibility (O_equals_one_thread_O) is the real check
